Prevention: Sweep floors and store walls clear of debris
Whitewash the walls to see weevils when climbing
Inspect walls for holes and cracks.
Stores/warehouses must be ventilated to allow free flow of air
Avoid laying bags on the floor, provide pallets for stacking
Stores/warehouses should be free of dirt and cob webs
Keep store surroundings clean; no planting of maize or other cereals near storage area
Dry rice seeds in the sun for 5-7 days to achieve a moisture content of 12-14% Clean and dry empty bags and sacks before filling with rice seeds or grains
Monitoring: Regularly inspect floor and walls of the store for signs of weevil remains
Every week randomly inspect bags and sacks for appearance of weevil remains
When weevils remains are present, take action from green direct control column
Place ear on stacks to listen to weevil movement within bags
Direct Control: Sun dry bags of infected rice seeds for 48 hours using either tarpaulin sheets or drying floor
Spread grains or seeds thinly and use rake to frequently move grains for effective coverage and proper drying
Mix 200 g of dry chilli pepper into 50 kg of rice bag to ensure that weevils are completely eradicated
Diazinon at the rate of 70 ml mixed in 5litres of water
Restrictions: Phostoxin is toxic avoid swallowing or inhaling fumes; Following fumigation, wait for two (2) weeks before consumption or sale of rice seeds avoid taking in residues of
Phostoxin should be two (2) times per month; Active ingredient (AI) is 30%; Use 2-4 tablets per ton; Use small container such as an empty tomato cup for each

Phostoxin tablet and place inside the container or around the stack or under the fumigation sheet; Drop fumigation sheet to reach the floor to prevent gas escape; Drop weights such as metal rods or sticks to ensure that the gas does not leak
